frame_source: Actual Panda3D window framebuffers. PNGs unmodified. GIFs resized to 768x432 and palette-encoded only; no concept/generated frames.
controlled_clips: Frames every 2/60 animation seconds; GIF frame duration 30ms (GIF has 10ms granularity). Final frame held 600ms. Public Controller drives reachable production paths.
native_clip: Native XTest key; normal app clock. Frame durations reconstructed from request progress differences; final held 600ms.
phase_annotation: Terminal frames identified by request=None and verified FELL at capture end; captured_phase preserves old QA label where it was roll/effects.
